difficulty_reason: Duality formula (statement 1173-1184, proof 1185-1203): the Euler characteristics of O_X and the dualizing complex agree, and in the Cohen-Macaulay equidimensional case chi(O_X) = -chi(omega_X) - the proof is a short complete computation through the duality isomorphism Ext^i(O_X, omega^bullet) = H^{-i}(O_X) and the CM identification omega^bullet = omega[1]; no verification is omitted. H2: duality bookkeeping.
